module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Synthesizable top-level integration wrapper that terminates the input command stream, response stream, and firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface, then coordinates parsing, validation, freshness supervision, safety gating, bounded storage, and response formatting.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Use a simple synchronous ready/valid intake path for ctrl_in and a separate ready/valid response path for ctrl_out. Combine parser validity, semantic validation, watchdog status, and safety results to qualify acceptance; on invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or internal fault conditions, inhibit actuator validity and latch sticky status for firmware handling rather than substituting a command.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Maintain only the minimal control/state required by the spec: sequence tracking, watchdog count, sticky fault latches, programmable bounds/thresholds, last accepted metadata, and a compact FSM state for acceptance/inhibition. Keep all state synchronous to clk and reset to an inhibited, non-driving condition.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive ctrl_in_ready, ctrl_out_valid, ctrl_out_data, csr_rdata, and csr_ready from real top-level RTL. Emit compact response frames for accepted frames or fault events, and expose CSR/MMIO readback and acknowledge semantics through the top-level outputs. Do not rely on child-only driving for required outputs.
ownership_notes: Owns the synthesizable design top and must not be replaced by a leaf, status, telemetry, or register-bank module.
Owns top-level response formatting and firmware-visible CSR/MMIO termination.
Must not expose tensors, geometry arrays, pressure maps, or large flow fields at top level.

module_microarchitecture.name: stream_rx_parser
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Fixed-width packet parser on the 128-bit control input stream, with shallow combinational decode and synchronous capture of accepted frame metadata.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Accept ctrl_in_data only when ctrl_in_valid and ctrl_in_ready are asserted. Decode opcode, sequence, age/timestamp summary, flow-condition summary, requested actuator target, and diagnostic bits using fixed bit slices within the 128-bit payload limit.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use minimal parser state only as needed to hold decoded fields and a parser-valid qualifier. Keep reset behavior benign and deassert frame validity until a new valid packet is accepted.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Produce rx_opcode, rx_seq, rx_age, rx_flow_mps, rx_actuator_target, rx_diag, and rx_frame_valid for downstream validation and status capture; do not alter or repair packet contents.
ownership_notes: Owns stream decode boundary for the incoming compact command packet.
Does not implement inference, CFD, geometry processing, or widened payload structures.

module_microarchitecture.name: request_validator
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Pure semantic/protocol checker for decoded command fields, with simple comparisons against programmed limits and tracked sequence state.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Classify legality of opcode, monotonic sequence progression, freshness/age, flow envelope, and target range. Pass only legality flags and the next expected/accepted sequence context downstream; do not modify the request.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Keep only the minimal sequence-tracking and policy-related state implied by the spec. Sequence tracking remains monotonic and bounded by implemented width.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive opcode_legal, seq_legal, freshness_legal, flow_legal, target_legal, frame_legal, and legal_seq_next for use by safety, sequencing, buffering, and status logic.
ownership_notes: Does not generate actuator commands or substitute alternate requests.

module_microarchitecture.name: watchdog_timer
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Cycle counter and freshness supervisor with synchronous counting and threshold compare logic.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Increment count while no accepted frame pulse is observed; reset/reload the count according to programmed preload policy on accepted frame activity or reset. Assert stale and communication-loss indications when inactivity exceeds configured limits.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use a single bounded counter and derived fault indications; no deep history or FIFO behavior is implied.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Expose watchdog_count, stale_fault, and comm_loss_fault for safety gating and CSR readback.
ownership_notes: Owns freshness counting and inactivity detection.
Does not generate commands or large storage structures.

module_microarchitecture.name: safety_manager
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Hard safety clamp and validity gate that enforces programmed actuator bounds before any actuation decision.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Clamp the requested target within target_min/target_max and safe_range_min/safe_range_max. Deassert actuator_valid whenever frame_legal is false or stale_fault, comm_loss_fault, or internal_fault is asserted. Report actuator_safe and clamp activity to downstream status/response logic.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use only minimal combinational/synchronous state needed to remember clamp activity and safe/inhibited indication per the implementation intent.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Produce clamped_target, target_clamp_event, actuator_safe, and actuator_valid; do not synthesize a substitute command when validity is inhibited.
ownership_notes: Owns hard clamping and validity inhibition policy.
Does not silently replace the requested command with an unrelated fallback command.

module_microarchitecture.name: cmd_buffer
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Small FPGA-friendly last-command capture storage for the last accepted command metadata only.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Capture metadata on accepted_frame_pulse and present the latest stored values to status and response logic. Keep the storage shallow and deterministic.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Store only the last accepted seq, age, flow summary, target, and diagnostic bits. No large FIFO, learned-history, or ASIC-style payload memory is implied.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Expose last_seq, last_age, last_flow_mps, last_target, and last_diag as observability readback for firmware and response generation.
ownership_notes: Does not implement a large history buffer.

module_microarchitecture.name: actuator_command_fsm
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact control FSM that sequences acceptance/inhibition around validated commands and freshness status.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Remain inhibited on reset and whenever faults are present. Allow acceptance only when a validated and fresh command is present; generate accepted_frame_pulse to notify downstream storage and watchdog logic.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use a small enumerated state encoding for IDLE, VALID_HOLD, APPLY, and inhibited/safe handling as implied by the spec, while keeping the implementation simple and synchronous.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive actuator_valid_out, state_id, and accepted_frame_pulse; maintain inhibited behavior by deasserting validity when safety or freshness conditions are not met.
ownership_notes: Owns command sequencing and acceptance pulse generation.
Does not generate or substitute a fallback command value.

module_microarchitecture.name: status_regs
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Firmware-visible CSR/MMIO register block with explicit decode, readback, write handling, and sticky status capture.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Decode the compact register map, acknowledge accesses through csr_ready, and return data via csr_rdata. Provide writable configuration registers for bounds and thresholds plus read-only status and sticky fault indicators.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Retain only the documented configuration fields, status fields, and sticky fault bits required by the register contract. All declared registers must be reachable through RTL decode.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive csr_rdata, csr_ready, sticky fault bits, applied_command, last_accepted_seq, watchdog_count, safe_state, and the programmable bounds/threshold outputs used by other blocks.
ownership_notes: Registers are not merely internal state; each declared register is reachable through decode.
The CSR/MMIO bus supplements, but does not replace, the streaming transport.

fsm_intent.name: actuator_command_fsm
fsm_intent.description: Simple acceptance/inhibition sequencing around validated commands. Reset enters the inhibited state. Transition toward APPLY only when a validated fresh command is available and no fault conditions are active. On fault or reset, inhibit actuator validity and do not substitute a command.

sequencing_notes: Input stream acceptance is only when ctrl_in_valid and ctrl_in_ready are both asserted.
The response stream uses ready/valid semantics independently of the input stream and may hold valid until accepted.
Accepted-frame indication is the single event used to update freshness supervision and last-command storage.
On invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions, inhibit actuator validity and latch fault status for software handling; do not silently replace the requested command.
All state updates are synchronous to clk and occur on the rising edge.
timing_notes: Keep combinational decode and compare paths shallow for FPGA timing.
Use only compact fixed-width fields and small bounded storage.
Avoid large register arrays; any deeper buffering, if ever needed, should map to FPGA memory macros rather than flattened flip-flops.
Do not instantiate Sky130 SRAM macros in the FPGA path.
consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
The top module remains adaptive_aero_control_top and is preserved as the synthesizable design top.
The CSR/MMIO register contract is taken from DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.register_contract and is treated as the source of truth for firmware-visible access.
